follow_up_questions.title: Constitutional and hemoptysis symptoms
follow_up_questions.question: Have you had any coughing up of blood, unexplained weight loss, night sweats, or loss of appetite?
follow_up_questions.why: These red flags for malignancy or infection were not asked and affect the urgency and work-up of the nodule.

follow_up_questions.title: Perioperative methotrexate plan
follow_up_questions.question: Do you know the exact methotrexate dose, and have you had any other immunosuppressants or recent lung problems from it? We should coordinate holding methotrexate around surgery with your rheumatologist.
follow_up_questions.why: Methotrexate can cause lung toxicity and affects infection risk and wound healing around VATS.

follow_up_questions.title: Smoking pack-years and exposures
follow_up_questions.question: How much did you smoke and for how many years? Any occupational exposures (hay or mold dust, asbestos), TB exposure, or travel to areas with endemic fungi?
follow_up_questions.why: Pack-years and exposures refine malignancy risk and the differential for an inflammatory or infectious nodule.

follow_up_questions.title: Prior imaging for comparison
follow_up_questions.question: Have you had any earlier chest imaging we can compare with the nodule to see if it has changed?
follow_up_questions.why: Nodule stability or growth changes the pretest probability and management.
